mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for future corporate earnings and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% over a 3-month window signals weakening labor market conditions, which may prompt the Fed to delay rate hikes or initiate easing, thereby supporting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to outperform baseline in 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both housing starts and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates weakening private demand, which triggers a policy response from the Fed to prevent economic contraction, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST and RSAFS decline (t-test p > 0.05), or the joint signal has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production below its 12-month moving average indicates a contraction in real output, which increases the likelihood of monetary accommodation and reduces recession risk, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during INDPRO below MA periods (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to generate positive returns in > 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in housing starts above 1.1 million units per month signals strong private sector demand, which supports consumer confidence and corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when HOUST exceeds 1100.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPIAUCSL above 2.5% year-over-year, combined with a stable FEDFUNDS rate, signals persistent inflationary pressure that may delay rate cuts, increasing real yields and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY and FEDFUNDS is stable (t-test p > 0.05), or the joint signal has Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in payroll employment and a decline in the unemployment rate signals a strong labor market, which may lead to tighter monetary policy and higher real rates, reducing equity attractiveness and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when PAYEMS rises >0.5% MoM and UNRATE < 4.7% (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption (RSAFS) below its 12-month moving average, combined with weak GDP growth (GDPC1), indicates a demand slowdown that increases the probability of Fed intervention, leading to positive equity returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both RSAFS < 12-month MA and GDPC1 < 1.5% QoQ (t-test p > 0.05), or the joint signal has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.
